sources.title: changh95/pi05-base-blackhole · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Project README π0.5 (Physical Intelligence 0.5) is a vision-language-action (VLA) model for robotics that combines a vision encoder, language model, and action expert for end-to-end robot control. This repository is a port of π0.5 to Tenstorrent hardware via TTNN, derived from lerobot/pi05_base.
